note: a straw skep on a plank stand (docs/29-world/09, 1.5.11): a gatherable, outlined, sways on click; gives honey every few game days (`hive`, src/hives.js, docs/43 section 6). bees_1 and bees_2 are optional click frames (bees stirring at the entrance); to use them add clickAnim {frames: [bees_1, bees_2, bees_1], ms: [160, 260, 160]} and the sway stops, as the well's does
